verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke yena Jekọp de nyo rẹ emọ ri Laban vwọ tanẹ, Jekọp ghwe eyere rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre reyọ, eyere rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre na kọye o vwo fe na.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke yena jekop de nyo re emo ri laban vwo tane jekop ghwe eyere re ose re avwanre reyo eyere re ose re avwanre na koye o vwo fe na

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp ke rha mrẹ vughe nẹ ivun rọye gbe rha vwerhe Laban kiri ọke rẹ ẹsosuọ-ọ.
verses.text_romanized: jekop ke rha mre vughe ne ivun roye gbe rha vwerhe laban kiri oke re esosuo o

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo da ta ki Jekọp, Rhivwi kpo otọ rẹ ọsẹ wẹn bru uvwiẹ wẹn, ki mi nene uwe dia.
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta ki jekop rhivwi kpo oto re ose wen bru uvwie wen ki mi nene uwe dia

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp de ji ikọ re se Rachel vi Leah rhe obo ẹghwa ro de churu eranvwe na,
verses.text_romanized: jekop de ji iko re se rachel vi leah rhe obo eghwa ro de churu eranvwe na

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da ta kẹ ayen, Ivun mẹ gbe sa vwerhe ọsẹ rẹ ovwan kirobo ri jovwo-o. Ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ mẹ na vẹ ovwẹ herọ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke ayen ivun me gbe sa vwerhe ose re ovwan kirobo ri jovwo o ekevuovo oghene re ose me na ve ovwe hero

verses.text_urhobo: Wa riẹnre nẹ ogangan mẹ ejobi Me vwọ ga ọsẹ wẹn,
verses.text_romanized: wa rienre ne ogangan me ejobi me vwo ga ose wen

verses.text_urhobo: yẹ ẹkẹvuọvo ọsẹ wẹn ghwa vwẹ re o de wene osa mẹ asiehwe; yẹ Ọghẹnẹ rhọvwere nẹ ọwavwẹ oma-a.
verses.text_romanized: ye ekevuovo ose wen ghwa vwe re o de wene osa me asiehwe ye oghene rhovwere ne owavwe oma a

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da dianẹ ọ tare nẹ, Igodẹ ri kerẹ ipe eye osa wẹn, igodẹ na ejobi mi vwiẹ iri kere ipe; ọ da rha tanẹ, Iri vẹ irhiẹ eye dia osa wẹn; igodẹ na ejobi mi rhe vwiẹ iri vẹ irhiẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da diane o tare ne igode ri kere ipe eye osa wen igode na ejobi mi vwie iri kere ipe o da rha tane iri ve irhie eye dia osa wen igode na ejobi mi rhe vwie iri ve irhie

verses.text_urhobo: Etiọye na Ọghẹnẹ vwọ reyọ uchuru rẹ ọsẹ wẹn ọ da vwẹ ayen kẹ vwẹ.
verses.text_romanized: etioye na oghene vwo reyo uchuru re ose wen o da vwe ayen ke vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ uchuru vwọ gba Me da vwerhẹ evwerhẹ mi vwo ni, Me da mrẹ ẹkpro rọ ruọ uchuru na, ẹvo vẹ irhiẹ, ẹvo vẹ ipe ẹvo pha bule bule.
verses.text_romanized: oke re uchuru vwo gba me da vwerhe evwerhe mi vwo ni me da mre ekpro ro ruo uchuru na evo ve irhie evo ve ipe evo pha bule bule

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin amakashe rẹ Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ vwẹ vwẹ evwerhẹ na, Jekọp, mi de nyo nẹ, Mẹvwẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin amakashe re oghene da ta ke vwe vwe evwerhe na jekop mi de nyo ne mevwe na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta, Kpare opharo rere wo ni, ẹkpro na ejobi re ruọ uchuru na e bẹrẹ irhiẹ, i kere ipe, ẹvo bule bule, kidie Me mrẹ obo ri Laban ru we.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta kpare opharo rere wo ni ekpro na ejobi re ruo uchuru na e bere irhie i kere ipe evo bule bule kidie me mre obo ri laban ru we

verses.text_urhobo: Mẹvwẹ Ọghẹnẹ ri Bẹtẹl, asan wọ da vwẹ evwri ghworo oragha re vwo vi na kugbe asan ri wo de vẹ ive kẹ vwẹ na. Gbe vrẹn vwẹ ọke na, ri wo rhivwi kpo nẹ otọ na, re wo kpo otọ re de vwiẹ wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: mevwe oghene ri betel asan wo da vwe evwri ghworo oragha re vwo vi na kugbe asan ri wo de ve ive ke vwe na gbe vren vwe oke na ri wo rhivwi kpo ne oto na re wo kpo oto re de vwie wen

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Rachel vi Leah da kpahe kẹ, Ẹkẹn ọfa eyẹ uku ji chekọ kẹ avwanre vwẹ uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre?
verses.text_romanized: etiyin rachel vi leah da kpahe ke eken ofa eye uku ji cheko ke avwanre vwe uwevwi re ose re avwanre

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ dianẹ avwanre họhọ ọrharha vwọ kẹ? Fikiridie ọ shẹ avwanre nure ọ ke je re igho rẹ avwanre nure.
verses.text_romanized: o diane avwanre hoho orharha vwo ke fikiridie o she avwanre nure o ke je re igho re avwanre nure

verses.text_urhobo: Ekuakua ejobi rẹ Ọghẹnẹ reyọ mie ọsẹ rẹ avwanre kẹ e rẹ avwanre vẹ emọ rẹ avwanre, Asakiephana kemu kemu rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ta kẹ wẹ, ọye wo ru.
verses.text_romanized: ekuakua ejobi re oghene reyo mie ose re avwanre ke e re avwanre ve emo re avwanre asakiephana kemu kemu re oghene ta ke we oye wo ru

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp de vrẹn, o de mu emọ rọye kugbe eya rọye phihọ enu rẹ iyesi;
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop de vren o de mu emo roye kugbe eya roye phiho enu re iyesi

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da djẹ uchuru rọye phihọ obaro, kugbe eranvwe ro vwori ejobi, uchuru ro vwori vwi Padanaram, rere o kpo otọ ri Kenan bru Aizik rẹ ọsẹ rọye ra.
verses.text_romanized: o da dje uchuru roye phiho obaro kugbe eranvwe ro vwori ejobi uchuru ro vwori vwi padanaram rere o kpo oto ri kenan bru aizik re ose roye ra

verses.text_urhobo: Laban yanran kpo ẹghwa ra bọrọ ẹto rẹ igegede, Rachel de cho oma rọ umukpe rẹ ọsẹ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: laban yanran kpo eghwa ra boro eto re igegede rachel de cho oma ro umukpe re ose roye

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp de reghe Laban rẹ ohwo rẹ Aram, kidie ọ ta kẹ nẹ ọye cha djẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: jekop de reghe laban re ohwo re aram kidie o ta ke ne oye cha dje e

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da bẹbẹ djẹ vi kemu kemu ro vwori ejobi, o de vrẹn ọ da sa urhie ri Yufratis mu, ọ da tọn opharo vi ugbenu rẹ orere ri Giliad.
verses.text_romanized: o da bebe dje vi kemu kemu ro vwori ejobi o de vren o da sa urhie ri yufratis mu o da ton opharo vi ugbenu re orere ri giliad

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ra vwọ vuẹ Laban vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ erha nẹ Jekọp djẹre,
verses.text_romanized: oke ra vwo vue laban vwe ede re erha ne jekop djere

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da reyọ imoni rọye ọ da vwọ tua ẹdẹ ighwrẹ soso kpata kpata ra ro orere rẹ igbenu ri Giliad.
verses.text_romanized: o da reyo imoni roye o da vwo tua ede ighwre soso kpata kpata ra ro orere re igbenu ri giliad

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ de bru Laban ohwo rẹ Aram na rhe vwẹ evwerhẹ vwẹ ason, ọ da ta kẹ, Jomaotọ, wo biko kpahe ota ki Jekọp rẹẹ, oyovwiri eyẹ omiovwiri.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo oghene de bru laban ohwo re aram na rhe vwe evwerhe vwe ason o da ta ke jomaoto wo biko kpahe ota ki jekop ree oyovwiri eye omiovwiri

verses.text_urhobo: Laban da yan mu Jekọp. Ọke yena Jekọp chivwi aphiana phihọ enu rẹ ugbenu, Laban vẹ imoni rọye de muerhọ phihọ enu rẹ ugbenu ri Giliad.
verses.text_romanized: laban da yan mu jekop oke yena jekop chivwi aphiana phiho enu re ugbenu laban ve imoni roye de muerho phiho enu re ugbenu ri giliad

verses.text_urhobo: Laban de ta ki Jekọp, Didi emu wo ruru na, ru wọ vwọ ghwa vwẹ re, ru wo vwo mu emetẹ mẹ kpo kiri ighuvwu re mu vwẹ ofovwi?
verses.text_romanized: laban de ta ki jekop didi emu wo ruru na ru wo vwo ghwa vwe re ru wo vwo mu emete me kpo kiri ighuvwu re mu vwe ofovwi

verses.text_urhobo: Die wọ vwọ bẹbẹ djẹ, wọ vwọ ghwa vwẹ re, ru wo vwo ju vwe ẹvuẹ, rere Me heha kẹ wẹ vẹ ekpata kugbe isoroguun?
verses.text_romanized: die wo vwo bebe dje wo vwo ghwa vwe re ru wo vwo ju vwe evue rere me heha ke we ve ekpata kugbe isoroguun

verses.text_urhobo: Kidie wo gbi ju vwe fiọnfiọn emọ mẹ unu rere mi yere ayen kẹdẹfa-a? Wo ru emu rẹ ẹkpa gangan.
verses.text_romanized: kidie wo gbi ju vwe fionfion emo me unu rere mi yere ayen kedefa a wo ru emu re ekpa gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Ogangan rhe vwe mi vwo ru we ghwaghwa; ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ wẹn ọye vuẹ vwẹ vwẹ ason na, nẹ, Jomaotọ wọ ta ota oyoyovwi eyẹ ọbrabra ki Jekọpu-u.
verses.text_romanized: ogangan rhe vwe mi vwo ru we ghwaghwa ekevuovo oghene re ose wen oye vue vwe vwe ason na ne jomaoto wo ta ota oyoyovwi eye obrabra ki jekopu u

verses.text_urhobo: Asakiephana wo ro kpo fikiridie urhuru rẹ uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ wẹn si we, ẹkẹvuọvo kidie wo rhe vwo cho ẹdjọ mẹ?
verses.text_romanized: asakiephana wo ro kpo fikiridie urhuru re uwevwi re ose wen si we ekevuovo kidie wo rhe vwo cho edjo me

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da kpahe ki Laban, Kidie oshọ mu vwe, ki mi rori nẹ wọ cha vwẹ ẹgba reyọ emetẹ wẹn mie vwe.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da kpahe ki laban kidie osho mu vwe ki mi rori ne wo cha vwe egba reyo emete wen mie vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Obọ ri kohwo kohwo ru wọ da mrẹ ẹdjọ wẹn na ko ghwu phihọ. Irharo rẹ imoni wẹn na vwẹ obọ te emu wo rori nẹ ọwẹn, rere wọ reyọ. Vwẹ ọke yena Jekọp riẹnre nẹ Rachel choro-o.
verses.text_romanized: obo ri kohwo kohwo ru wo da mre edjo wen na ko ghwu phiho irharo re imoni wen na vwe obo te emu wo rori ne owen rere wo reyo vwe oke yena jekop rienre ne rachel choro o

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Laban da ro utughẹ ri Jekọp, ọ da ro utughẹ ri Leah, kugbe utughẹ rẹ ayeobọ ivẹ na, ẹkẹvuọvo ọ mrẹ aye-en. O de vrẹn nẹ utughẹ ri Leah ọ da ro utughẹ ri Rachel.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin laban da ro utughe ri jekop o da ro utughe ri leah kugbe utughe re ayeobo ive na ekevuovo o mre aye en o de vren ne utughe ri leah o da ro utughe ri rachel

verses.text_urhobo: Yi Rachel ghine, reyọ oma rọ umukpe rẹ ọsẹ rọye o de sionu vwẹ ekoso rẹ iyesi rọye o de tidia botọ Laban da vwẹ obọ gbe ekuakua rẹ uwevwi na ejobi, jọ mrẹrẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: yi rachel ghine reyo oma ro umukpe re ose roye o de sionu vwe ekoso re iyesi roye o de tidia boto laban da vwe obo gbe ekuakua re uwevwi na ejobi jo mrere e

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ ọsẹ rọye nẹ, Wo jẹ ivun miovwo ọrovwovwe ri mi vwo je vrẹ-ẹn, kidie idjerhe rẹ eya na ra nyẹ vwẹ. Kọye ọ da guọnọ, ẹkẹvuọvo ọ sa mrẹ oma rọ umukpe rọye na-a.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke ose roye ne wo je ivun miovwo orovwovwe ri mi vwo je vre en kidie idjerhe re eya na ra nye vwe koye o da guono ekevuovo o sa mre oma ro umukpe roye na a

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ivun de rhi miovwo Jekọp, ọ da ghwo ku Laban, Jekọp da ta ki Laban, Didi ogbeku wọ mrẹ vwẹ obọ mẹ? Ọ rhọ umwemwu mẹ, ru wọ vwọ tua vwẹ?
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ivun de rhi miovwo jekop o da ghwo ku laban jekop da ta ki laban didi ogbeku wo mre vwe obo me o rho umwemwu me ru wo vwo tua vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Dede na wọ hra uwevwi mẹ ejobi re, ki didi ekuakua wẹn wọ mrẹre vwẹ uwevwi mẹ? Gba vwọ phia kẹ imoni wẹn kugbe imoni mẹ rere ayen brorhiẹ mẹ vẹ ọwẹn.
verses.text_romanized: dede na wo hra uwevwi me ejobi re ki didi ekuakua wen wo mrere vwe uwevwi me gba vwo phia ke imoni wen kugbe imoni me rere ayen brorhie me ve owen

verses.text_urhobo: Ikpe uje soso Me vẹ ọwẹn vwọ herọ re, ogodẹ wẹn eyẹ ẹvwe wẹn ji vwiẹ chọra-a, mi ji hwe egbo rẹ uchuru wẹn ree.
verses.text_romanized: ikpe uje soso me ve owen vwo hero re ogode wen eye evwe wen ji vwie chora a mi ji hwe egbo re uchuru wen ree

verses.text_urhobo: Ogodẹ rẹ eranvwe hweri mi vwo rhe we-e, Me hwa osa rọye kẹ wẹn, eranvwe re chori ason eyẹ uvo obọ mẹ wọ da nọ ekpẹn rọye.
verses.text_romanized: ogode re eranvwe hweri mi vwo rhe we e me hwa osa roye ke wen eranvwe re chori ason eye uvo obo me wo da no ekpen roye

verses.text_urhobo: Kẹ ọtiọye mi epha, uvo mu vwe kẹdẹ kẹdẹ, ekpae kason kason, ovwerhẹ rẹ obọ mẹ da mrẹ vwẹ djẹ
verses.text_romanized: ke otioye mi epha uvo mu vwe kede kede ekpae kason kason ovwerhe re obo me da mre vwe dje

verses.text_urhobo: Ikpe uje soso nana Me dia uwevwi wẹn, Me ga wẹn ikpe ihwẹne fiki rẹ emetẹ wẹn ivẹ; ikpe esan fiki rẹ uchuru wẹn, wo de wene osa mẹ abọ ihwe soso.
verses.text_romanized: ikpe uje soso nana me dia uwevwi wen me ga wen ikpe ihwene fiki re emete wen ive ikpe esan fiki re uchuru wen wo de wene osa me abo ihwe soso

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ dianẹ kẹ Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ mẹ, Ọghẹnẹ rẹ Ebraham kugbe oshọ rẹ Aizik nene uvwe dia vwo-o, yo muẹro nẹ abọ ofefe wa vwọ djẹ vwẹ kpọ, Ọghẹnẹ mrẹ oma elaghọ mẹ kugbe owian rẹ abọ mẹ, ọ da ghwọ ku we ason rọ wanre na.
verses.text_romanized: o diane ke oghene re ose me oghene re ebraham kugbe osho re aizik nene uvwe dia vwo o yo muero ne abo ofefe wa vwo dje vwe kpo oghene mre oma elagho me kugbe owian re abo me o da ghwo ku we ason ro wanre na

verses.text_urhobo: Laban de nyo ọ da kpahe ki Jekọp; Emetẹ na emọmẹọ, emọ rayen na emọ mẹ, uchuru na ji emẹ rhe, emu ejobi ru wọ mrẹ na emẹ. Ẹkẹvuọvo kidie mi se ru nonẹ na vwọ kẹ emetẹ mẹ na, eyẹ vwọ kẹ emọ rayen vwiẹri?
verses.text_romanized: laban de nyo o da kpahe ki jekop emete na emomeo emo rayen na emo me uchuru na ji eme rhe emu ejobi ru wo mre na eme ekevuovo kidie mi se ru none na vwo ke emete me na eye vwo ke emo rayen vwieri

verses.text_urhobo: Yanrhe, rere Me vẹ owẹ rẹ ọphọ, mẹvwẹ kugbe owẹ, rere ọ dia iseri kẹ vwẹ vẹ owẹ
verses.text_romanized: yanrhe rere me ve owe re opho mevwe kugbe owe rere o dia iseri ke vwe ve owe

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp da reyọ ubioragha o de muo vi goro.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop da reyo ubioragha o de muo vi goro

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da ta ke ihwo rọye, Wa ghwẹ ibieragha, ayen da ghwẹ ibieragha na, ayen da ma ayen osusu na.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da ta ke ihwo roye wa ghwe ibieragha ayen da ghwe ibieragha na ayen da ma ayen osusu na

verses.text_urhobo: Laban de se Jegarsahadutha. ẹkẹvuọvo Jekọp de rhe se Galeed.
verses.text_romanized: laban de se jegarsahadutha ekevuovo jekop de rhe se galeed

verses.text_urhobo: Laban da ta, Osusu nana ri goro na ọye iseri kẹ vwẹ vẹ owẹ nonẹ na. Fiki rẹ ọtiọye na o de se Galeed,
verses.text_romanized: laban da ta osusu nana ri goro na oye iseri ke vwe ve owe none na fiki re otioye na o de se galeed

verses.text_urhobo: Osusu na ki Mizpah, kidie ọ tare nẹ, Ọrovwohwo rhẹrẹ owẹ vẹ ovwẹ, ọke rẹ avwanre da hẹriẹ oma nẹ ohwohwo.
verses.text_romanized: osusu na ki mizpah kidie o tare ne orovwohwo rhere owe ve ovwe oke re avwanre da herie oma ne ohwohwo

verses.text_urhobo: Wo de miovwo emetẹ mẹ na ẹyọrọ, eyẹ wọ da rọvwọ eya efa ba emọ mẹ na, dede na ohwo ọfa etinẹ na, karophihọ nẹ Ọghẹnẹ iseri mẹ vẹ owẹ.
verses.text_romanized: wo de miovwo emete me na eyoro eye wo da rovwo eya efa ba emo me na dede na ohwo ofa etine na karophiho ne oghene iseri me ve owe

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Laban da ta ki Jekọp, Ni osusu nana vẹ ekru nana, ri mi mu vi vwẹ uvwre mẹ vẹ ọwẹn na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin laban da ta ki jekop ni osusu nana ve ekru nana ri mi mu vi vwe uvwre me ve owen na

verses.text_urhobo: Ekru nana iseri, osusu nana ji iseri rhe, nẹ Me sa shariẹ ekru nana bru we rhe-e, eyẹ ekpuyovwi wẹn sa shariẹ ekru na bru vwe rhe ri ru emu-u.
verses.text_romanized: ekru nana iseri osusu nana ji iseri rhe ne me sa sharie ekru nana bru we rhe e eye ekpuyovwi wen sa sharie ekru na bru vwe rhe ri ru emu u

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ rẹ Ebraham kugbe Ọghẹnẹ ri Nahọr, Ọghẹnẹ rẹ esẹ rayen, brorhiẹ rẹ avwanre. Etiyin Jekọp da vwẹ Oshọ rẹ ọsẹ rọye Aizik vwo duvwu iyori.
verses.text_romanized: oghene re ebraham kugbe oghene ri nahor oghene re ese rayen brorhie re avwanre etiyin jekop da vwe osho re ose roye aizik vwo duvwu iyori

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp de ze izobo vwẹ enu rẹ ugbenu na o de se ihwo rọye nẹ iri re emu, ayen da re ayen da vwerhẹ enu rẹ ugbenu na.
verses.text_romanized: jekop de ze izobo vwe enu re ugbenu na o de se ihwo roye ne iri re emu ayen da re ayen da vwerhe enu re ugbenu na

verses.text_urhobo: Irhiọke ride Laban de vrẹn, ọ da fiọnfiọn ivwrọmọ rọye kugbe emetẹ rọye unu ọ da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ ayen, o de kuoma rhẹriẹ o de rhivwi kpo.
verses.text_romanized: irhioke ride laban de vren o da fionfion ivwromo roye kugbe emete roye unu o da ne erhovwo ke ayen o de kuoma rherie o de rhivwi kpo

headings.text_urhobo: Jekọp dje ne asan ri Laban
headings.text_romanized: jekop dje ne asan ri laban

headings.text_urhobo: Jekọp vẹ Laban rhi Kuoma gbe
headings.text_romanized: jekop ve laban rhi kuoma gbe
